It fixes the team blockers: assistant turns on, bounded parallel dispatch built but default 1. It also builds DingTalk, WeCom, the egress proxy and the sandbox image as unwired packages. T0 authors the single p1.0 contract batch in parallel. CONTRACT MECHANICS (graft from platform-first). The T0 patch writes ONLY proto/aite/v1/**, core/crates/contracts/**, core/crates/proto (convert.rs + tests), the ContractVersion line of edge/internal/server/server.go and config/aite.example.yaml. No cloud track can or may edit those files, so anchors cannot drift, there is no freeze/rebase step, and nothing depends on a cloud session surviving for days. The human applies the patch on branch contract/p1.0 after wave 1 and P0-CLOSE are on main. They run make proto-gen locally (committed headers pin protoc v7.36.1; cloud protoc 31.x output is never committed) and relock with an aite binary built BEFORE the patch (lock.rs only hashes proto/aite/v1 and core/crates/contracts on disk, verified). They check only the contracts + proto-crate tests, lock --check = OK 26 files, and go build. Companion track T0c (wave 2a, alone) checks out that branch and makes the workspace compile: literal sites; the five literal p0.2 pins outside the lock (main_test.go:202, evidence/tests/manifest.rs:65, evals_runner.rs:111, protocol_probe.rs:523, cli_smoke.rs:481, all verified); Services threading; Go optional interfaces; the Reaction counter-only R4 arm; and the parallel-dispatch flip. BEHAVIOUR FLIPS AND APP-TEST OWNERSHIP (must_fix). Assistant turns: CC3, default on; it owns reconnect_replay.rs and sqlite_cross_process.rs (crash_recovery is unaffected, verified). Parallel dispatch: CC2 ships with_max_parallel(1); T0c flips it from WorkerConfig.max_parallel_tasks=4 and owns app/**. Receipts go to review/p1/ledger/<ID>.md, because cloud PRs cannot splice a shared ledger. One draft PR per track. Stop and report on any locked/R0/new-dependency need. Docker tests are hermetic (no public hosts from containers). Cloud-generated edge/gen is never committed. Live model keys never go into the cloud environment. CI runs only on PRs, main pushes and manual dispatch. Known timing flakes (graceful_shutdown, startup_recovery, reconnect_replay, edge cmd/aite-edge under -race) are rerun singly before being called regressions.
